papers.title: SkillTester: Benchmarking Utility and Security of Agent Skills
papers.abstract: This technical report presents SkillTester, a tool for evaluating the utility and security of agent skills. Its evaluation framework combines paired baseline and with-skill execution conditions with a separate security probe suite. Grounded in a comparative utility principle and a user-facing simplicity principle, the framework normalizes raw execution artifacts into a utility score, a security score, and a three-level security status label. More broadly, it can be understood as a comparative quality-assurance harness for agent skills in an agent-first world. The public service is deployed at https://skilltester.ai, and the broader project is maintained at https://github.com/skilltester-ai/skilltester.
papers.comment: Technical report, 13 pages, 2 figures, 9 tables. Project page: https://skilltester.ai. Code: https://github.com/skilltester-ai/skilltester
